items.title: Ed Soph interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 9, 2024
items.q: He has shared the bandstand with Woody Herman, Joe Williams, Clark Terry, and numerous other jazz luminaries.

ctx.x: Ed Soph has balanced a successful career in jazz as a valued drummer and distinguished educator. He has shared the bandstand with Woody Herman, Joe Williams, Clark Terry, and numerous other jazz luminaries.
Ed was interviewed via Zoom on February 9, 2024 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
